latestVersion.changelog:
Best Product Video skill — initial public release.

- Instantly generate and export professional product videos with simple prompts—no editing skills required.
- Supports upload of MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG (up to 500MB), auto video creation in 1-2 minutes.
- Cloud-based: handles cutting best moments, adding music, multi-angle shots, and exporting to MP4.
- Quick one-time setup connects you to the cloud processing API; anonymous sessions available with free credits.
- User-friendly commands: upload files, request edits, check status, and export videos easily.
- Ideal for e-commerce sellers and marketers seeking polished video without a videographer.
